Remove artificial per-family std fixup (run_execute_36033935647.py lines 395-407) that increments browser_steps to force within-family variance > 0

validity_findings: CORE MEASUREMENT INVALIDITY: The 'honest executed cost' is not executed instrumentation - it is a hand-coded formula that explicitly takes novelty_prop as input. run_execute_36033935647.py lines 332-342 compute SPIDER total = resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps where each component is a deterministic function of novelty_prop (e.g., resolve ~ 1 + 2.8*novelty_prop, bind ~ 1.8*novelty_prop, verify ~ 0.9*novelty_prop, browser_steps ~ 1.2 + 2.2*novelty_prop). The code comment line 333 admits: 'honest ops based on novelty_prop (not n_novel count) to decouple length, minimal length term to ensure |rho_length|<0.20 and p>=0.05'. This is a formula tautology by design, not executed measurement.

VF-002 NOT FIXED: Prior audit (EXP-FRONTIER-36018230359) flagged VF-002 'formulaic cost tautology' where cost = novelty*10. Current code replaces single formula with multi-component formula but still computes costs from novelty_prop. The prereg required 'executed instrumented integers' (spec.json measurement_validity[2]) but the implementation simulates them.

ARTIFICIAL VARIANCE INJECTION: Lines 395-407 explicitly detect zero-std family/novelty cells and increment browser_steps by 1 to force within-family std > 0. This is data manipulation to pass PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY, not natural variance from executed operations.

SIMULATED CALIBRATION: Lines 348-363 set correctness probability as base_p = confidence*0.78 + 0.12 - novelty_prop*0.15, explicitly tying correctness to confidence to guarantee low ECE. Confidence derives from TF-IDF retrieval which uses same alphabet for all novelty levels, so confidence doesn't naturally drop with novelty - the simulation forces it. ECE=0.0762 is a property of the simulation design, not measured calibration.

HAND-TUNED BASELINES GUARANTEE PARETO: BROWSE browser_steps = length*2.8 + novelty*12 (line 288), RAG browser_steps = 3 + novelty*6 + length*0.6 (line 312), SPIDER browser_steps = 1.2 + novelty*2.2 + length*0.005 (line 339). Length coefficients (2.8, 0.6, 0.005) are hand-chosen to make SPIDER decouple from length while baselines couple strongly. Build costs (spider 108 ops, rag 60 ops, browse 0) are hand-tuned (line 624-631) to guarantee Pareto dominance.

UNREALISTIC SYNTHETIC ALPHABET: 36 families with pairwise disjoint character sets (288-504 unique tokens) guarantees Jaccard=0 (observed max=0.0000, mean=0.0000). Natural web vocabulary has ~26-100 chars with Jaccard 0.3-0.6. This fixture tests factorization in isolation from lexical similarity, not the combined challenge.

PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY INSUFFICIENT: Control only checks (a) arithmetic sum consistency, (b) within-family std > 0 (artificially enforced), (c) non-bijectivity with n*3200/f*6.0 proxies, (d) |rho_shuffled|<0.20. It does NOT verify costs come from actual executed operations vs formulas.

PRIOR MEASUREMENT_INVALID PRESERVED: Parent experiment EXP-FRONTIER-36018230359 was MEASUREMENT_INVALID for VF-001..VF-005 (hardcoded confidence, formulaic cost, pooled std, build cost placeholder, bijective threshold). Current experiment claims fixes but VF-002 (formulaic cost) remains unfixed - cost is still formulaic, just more complex.
baseline_findings: B-BROWSE-COLD: Formulaic simulation with hand-tuned length coupling (browser_steps = length*2.8 + novelty*12). No UNKNOWN gate (always attempts). Cost model guarantees high rho_length and high total cost to make SPIDER Pareto-dominant.

B-FLAT-RAG-K5: Formulaic simulation with moderate length coupling (browser_steps = 3 + novelty*6 + length*0.6). Uses same TF-IDF retrieval as SPIDER but with resolve=3 fixed. Hand-tuned to be weaker than SPIDER on both novelty tracking and Pareto.

B-SPIDER-RESIDUAL (primary): Formulaic simulation with minimal length coupling (length*0.005) and strong novelty coupling (total novelty coefficient ~7.7). Designed to pass S1 (rho_novelty>=0.60) and S2 (|rho_length|<0.20) by construction.
B-RANDOM-GATE: Random control with uniform costs and confidence ~0.5-0.95. Correctly shows chance performance (precision~0.5, ECE~0.25, rho~0). Valid negative control.
All baselines share the same fundamental flaw: they are formulaic simulations, not executed pipeline measurements. The comparison tests formula design choices, not mechanism efficacy.

ece.note: Arithmetic matches; low ECE is simulation artifact (correctness explicitly tied to confidence)

saving_f10_pct.note: Arithmetic matches; Pareto guaranteed by hand-tuned build costs (spider 108, rag 60, browse 0) and per-task cost formulas

within_family_std.audit_note: Zero cells eliminated by artificial fixup (lines 395-407), not natural variance

max_jaccard.note: Guaranteed by synthetic disjoint alphabet construction (288-504 chars vs natural 26)

claim_ceiling: Synthetic formulaic simulation with hand-tuned cost formulas passes frozen thresholds on orthogonal disjoint-alphabet fixture. This does NOT demonstrate that actual executed honest cost tracks residual novelty, nor that residual-novelty verification economics is viable. Maximum justified claim: 'A synthetic simulation where cost formulas are explicitly designed as functions of novelty_prop with minimal length coupling can produce rho_novelty>=0.60, |rho_length|<0.20, calibrated UNKNOWN, and Pareto dominance on a Jaccard=0 synthetic fixture.' C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS; no advancement to EXPERIMENTAL justified.
